modules.title: MET B2 Writing — Short Answer Questions

items.prompt: Write about a time you had to make an important decision. What did you consider before deciding?
items.rubric: Should mention at least two factors, explain the outcome, and use past tenses accurately.

items.prompt: Describe a place in your city that you think more tourists should visit. Why is it special?
items.rubric: Should include specific details about the place and explain why it deserves more attention.

items.prompt: What are the advantages and disadvantages of working from home? Give your opinion.
items.rubric: Should present at least one advantage and one disadvantage with supporting reasons.

items.prompt: Explain how regular exercise can improve mental health. Use specific examples.
items.rubric: Should link physical activity to mental wellbeing with at least two concrete benefits.

items.prompt: Do you think children should learn a foreign language from a young age? Why or why not?
items.rubric: Should present a clear position with at least two supporting arguments.
